title: The Lantern of Port Mahon
author: Mirabel Quintana
blurb: Xanthe Delacroix, a widowed lighthouse keeper during the year of the great storms, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. Then a child is left at the door with instructions to forget the face — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must smuggle the evidence past three checkpoints before the armistice is signed — or isn't.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
